Start date: 1245-09-04  
39 weeks = 39 × 7 = 273 days.  
Add 273 + 1 = 274 days.  

1245 is not a leap year (divisible by 1250? No, but rule: divisible by 4, but not by 100 unless divisible by 400; 1245 mod 4 = 1, so not leap).  
Days remaining in 1245 after Sep 4:  
Sep: 30 - 4 = 26  
Oct: 31  
Nov: 30  
Dec: 31  
Total = 26+31+30+31 = 118 days.  

274 - 118 = 156 days into 1246.  
1246 is not leap (1246 mod 4 = 2).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30.  
Cumulative: Jan 31, Feb 59, Mar 90, Apr 120, May 151, Jun 181.  
156 days: up to May 151 leaves 5 more days → June 5.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1246-06-05
